1.text: Uwo mwana Samweli yakoreraga Uwiteka imbere ya Eli. Kandi muri iyo minsi ijambo ry'Imana ryari ingume, nta kwerekwa kwari kweruye.

2.text: Icyo gihe Eli yari atangiye guhuma, atakibona. Bukeye mu maryama ajya ku buriri bwe,

3.text: itara ry'Imana ryari ritarazima kandi Samweli yari aryamye mu rusengero rw'Uwiteka, aho isanduku y'Imana iba.

4.text: Maze Uwiteka ahamagara Samweli na we ati “Karame!”

5.text: Arirukanka asanga Eli ati “Nditabye kuko umpamagaye.”Eli ati “Singuhamagaye subira kuryama.” Nuko asubira kuryama.

6.text: Uwiteka yongera guhamagara Samweli, arabaduka asanga Eli aravuga ati “Nditabye kuko umpamagaye.”Aramusubiza ati “Mwana wanjye, singuhamagaye subira kuryama.”

7.text: Ariko Samweli yari ataramenya Uwiteka, kandi atarahishurirwa n'ijambo rye.

8.text: Uwiteka ahamagara Samweli ubwa gatatu. Arabaduka asanga Eli ati “Nditabye kuko umpamagaye.”Maze Eli amenya ko ari Uwiteka uhamagaye uwo mwana.

9.text: Ni ko kubwira Samweli ati “Genda subira kuryama. Niyongera kuguhamagara umusubize uti ‘Uwiteka, vuga kuko umugaragu wawe nteze amatwi.’ ” Nuko Samweli asubira kuryama aho yari ari.

10.text: Maze Uwiteka araza ahagarara aho, aramuhamagara nk'ubwa mbere ati “Samweli, Samweli!”Na we ati “Umbwire kuko umugaragu wawe nteze amatwi.”

11.text: Nuko Uwiteka abwira Samweli ati “Dore nzakora ikintu muri Isirayeli, uzacyumva wese amatwi azacura injereri.

12.text: Uwo munsi nzasohoreza Eli ibyo navuze ku nzu ye byose, uhereye mu itangira ryabyo ukageza mu iherezo ryabyo.

13.text: Namubwiye ko nzacira inzu ye urubanza rw'iteka ryose mbahōra gukiranirwa yamenye, kuko abahungu be bizaniye umuvumo ntababuze.

14.text: Ni cyo cyatumye ndahirira inzu ya Eli nti ‘Icyaha cy'inzu ya Eli ntikizahongererwa icyiru cy'igitambo cyangwa amaturo iteka ryose.’ ”

15.text: Nuko Samweli araryama ageza mu gitondo, bukeye akingura inzugi z'inzu y'Uwiteka ariko atinya kubwira Eli ibyo yeretswe.

16.text: Nuko Eli ahamagara Samweli aramubwira ati “Mwana wanjye Samweli.”Na we ati “Karame!”

17.text: Aramubaza ati “Uwiteka yakubwiye iki? Ndakwinginze ntumpishe. Numpisha ikintu na kimwe mu byo yakubwiye byose, Uwiteka abiguhōre ndetse akurushirizeho.”

18.text: Samweli amurondorera byose ntiyagira icyo amuhisha. Nuko Eli aramusubiza ati “Ni Uwiteka, nakore icyo ashaka.”

19.text: Samweli arakura, Uwiteka abana na we ntiyakunda ko hagira ijambo na rimwe rya Samweli rigwa hasi.

20.text: Nuko Abisirayeli bose, uhereye i Dani ukageza i Bērisheba, bamenya ko Samweli yarundukiye mu buhanuzi bw'Uwiteka.

21.text: Maze Uwiteka yongera kumubonekerera i Shilo, kuko yajyaga yiyereka Samweli n'ijambo rye i Shilo. Kandi ijambo rya Samweli rigera ku Bisirayeli bose.
